rows.grounds: locative of bhūpradeśa, indicating the place on the earth
locative of sama, qualifying the ground as even
fused form of ca and āḍhye, indicating an elevated place as alternative or additional quality
instrumental of sindūrarajas, specifying the drawing substance

items.question: On what kind of ground and with what substance may the Śrīcakra be drawn?
premises: The drawing place may be a level spot on the ground.
The drawing place may alternatively be an elevated spot on the ground.
Vermilion powder is specified as the substance for drawing.
items.inference: The Śrīcakra may be drawn with vermilion powder on a level or elevated ground spot.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of cāḍhye as an alternative to same or as an additional qualification is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: On a level or elevated spot on the ground, it may be drawn with vermilion powder, or alternatively.
